notes.title: Multiplayer Available Now!
notes.content:
Get ready to explore the Wilderness with your friends with the new multiplayer update. After several months of development we have managed to add a multiplayer option to Wilderness with new movement systems and a completely new map.

Now with multiplayer we have added the option to comnunicate with Voice Chat in order to add a more entertaining experience to the game.

It's been a hard few months where we had to start from scratch several times, and we would appreciate it if you would try the new update and report all the bugs you may have found and the aspects to improve.

You can join now the Wilderness Discord, where we will be happy to read your comments.

[url=https://discord.gg/JeeXvsvePy]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Wilderness Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hi, it has been a while since the last news but we are still working on Wilderness.

During this time we've fixed some bugs and the most important the save system which caused problems during the launch day, we also improved/fixed the basics and the bugs of the game.

- Fixed Save System for human
- Reduced building cost
- Bear AI attack won't trap you
- Reduced amount of human AI
- Metal Axe now showing in the radial menu

As well we started working on the multiplayer with dedicated servers, right now it works well and fluidly but we want to test more the multiplayer and give an update with good content and performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633771/921816b401dc6a0ec86b4a0761153d851903f3c9.jpg[/img]

Also for an upcoming update we are adding a new map inspired in the African Savanna where we will be adding some new type of animals like lions, zebras…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633771/9f70e4aff03b01777345aadf6b811d009b7762a6.png[/img]

We hope in the next weeks we can update the game with new features.

notes.title: Wilderness Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Changed Human AI collision
- Bear AI getting stuck fixed
- Stone Pickaxe now showing in radial menu
- Changed dead chicken collision
- Guides notifications overlapping fixed
- Added load buttons in pause menu for human character

notes.title: Wilderness Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Crafting bug fixed
- Human AI loot now only spawn once
- Fixed wolf and bear eating system
- Door trigger now is hidden
- Added detailed collision to window frame wall
- Now you can swim on all lakes
- Added more quick guides
- Added blood effect to Bear
- Only spawn one wolf from cage
- Reduced amount of AI that spawns into the world
- Pistol sound loop fixed

notes.title: Fixing bugs
notes.content: Currently we are fixing some of the main bugs like being unable to craft rope

notes.title: WILDERNESS IS LIVE!!
notes.content: Wilderness is now available. We hope you like the first version of the game and that you understand that there is still work to be done. Our next goal is to implement multiplayer and publish it with a new map. We really want to implement more content and if you have any suggestions or features that you would like to see implemented in the game, let us know via email or by joining our Discord server. Thank you very much for the wait.
